name: humanfallback-apilib
description: HumanFallback is a marketplace of verified humans that an AI agent can hire.  The API exposes the full delegation loop:  1. `POST /api/agent/parse` turns a natural-language request into a structured task. 2. `POST /api/agent/match` ranks nearby humans and explains each match. 3. `POST /api/tasks` creates the task and a quote. 4. `POST /api/tasks/{id}/pay` and `/capture` run the PayPal Orders v2 flow. 5. `POST /api/tasks/{id}/evidence` and `/verify` attach evidence and a vision verdict. 6. `POST /api/tasks/{id}/transition` moves the task through its lifecycle.  Session authentication uses an httpOnly cookie set by `/api/auth/login`. The MCP surface at `/api/mcp` exposes the same capabilities to agents.
